# XiaoTongYu

> The official personal website and portfolio of XiaoTongYu, a software engineer based in Beijing working on product engineering, AI applications, creative coding, and web experiences.

Canonical website: https://www.xiaotongyu.com/
Languages: Simplified Chinese and English

## Creator

- Public name: XiaoTongYu
- Chinese name: 肖彤宇
- Occupation: Software Engineer
- Location: Beijing, China
- Contact: work@xiaotongyu.com

XiaoTongYu is the public name used throughout this website. The canonical website and public profiles below identify the creator and their work.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/): XiaoTongYu's personal workbench, current interests, and project overview. [中文首页](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/zh).
- [About XiaoTongYu](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/about): Background, product and engineering interests, and public profiles. [中文介绍](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/zh/about).
- [Selected work](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/work): XiaoTongYu's products and experiments, with project descriptions and official links. [中文作品](https://www.xiaotongyu.com/zh/work).

## Selected work

- [Mewa](https://mewa.site/welcome/): A proactive AI companion and a community for friends, with shared conversations, fresh ideas, and ongoing goal follow-through.
- [CornAgent](https://cornagent.xiaotongyu.com/chat): An AI assistant for conversations, web search, and tasks powered by tools.
- [Myrisle](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/%E7%A7%81%E5%B1%BF/id6759214981): A private, local-first AI diary for iOS.
- [Petspace](https://petspace.xiaotongyu.com/): A web community for sharing everyday life with pets.
